subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If a review-role mapping is missing, malformed, incompatible, weakening, unqualified, cannot satisfy the joined demand, or the actual launch differs from the resolved harness/role/native settings, then the system shall stop before invocation where possible; otherwise record `route_execution_mismatch`, invalidate the affected pass evidence, retain the selected harness, and keep the process non-accepting
intent: invalid/unsupported route or mismatched launch with unmet/differing components
fit_criterion: every negative mapping fixture invokes zero affected passes; every launch-mismatch fixture produces no accepting pass evidence; all retain harness and preserve independent unaffected work
